meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会当“安装医生”:检查电脑里的 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 是否健康、版本是否最新,并对照官方最新源码逐项核对,最后给出一份带证据的通过/警告/失败报告和修复建议。诊断期间不会改动你的配置或文件。
howto.when: 当你说出“LazyCodex”“lazycodex-ai”“omo-codex”等关键词,要求做 doctor/健康检查,或 Codex 在安装、更新、配置改动后行为异常,或怀疑安装过时、漂移、损坏时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下电脑上的 LazyCodex 和 Codex 安装是否正常。
say.note: 会下载最新源码并核对,给出通过/警告/失败报告。

say.text: Codex 更新后行为异常,帮我诊断一下哪里出了问题。
say.note: 会检查版本、配置和插件接线,并给出修复建议。

say.text: 把我的本地 LazyCodex 和最新源码做个对比,看有没有偏差。
say.note: 会同步最新代码,标出过时或失效的引用。

howto.what_en: Claude checks LazyCodex and Codex CLI health against the latest sources and emits a PASS/WARN/FAIL report, each verdict backed by command output or file, with fixes. It never modifies your install, config, or repos during diagnosis.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'LazyCodex', 'lazycodex-ai', 'omo-codex', ask for a doctor or health check, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Check whether my LazyCodex and Codex CLI installs are healthy.
say_en.note: It fetches latest sources and compares them, then reports.

say_en.text: Codex is acting weird after the update; can you diagnose it?
say_en.note: It inspects versions, config, wiring; suggests fixes.

say_en.text: Compare my local LazyCodex install with the latest source for drift.
say_en.note: It syncs the latest code and flags any stale references.
